a: About 250–300 awards and $280M in total; size varies
e: US institution faculty; no limit on proposals per PI. NSF 26-517 merges the MCB (24-539), IOS and DEB core solicitations. Proposers no longer pick a division or cluster (e.g., Molecular Biophysics), because BIO now sorts proposals centrally.
n: NSF Core Research in Biological Sciences (BIO Core; formerly MCB incl. Molecular Biophysics cluster)
